evidence.reason: Line 214 still filters candidate scripts by whether the full target name is a literal token or a substring of the command. For `prepare: run-s build:*`, the runner marks the selection ambiguous, but `build:deps` is neither a literal token nor a substring of `run-s build:*`, so it is omitted from `relevant()`. A change to `build:deps` can therefore leave the dependency-root comparison unchanged even though `run-s` executes it, which is a real install-input correctness defect.
